intro.h2: Cabinets made to fit your kitchen
paragraphs: Chapel Cabinet Company is a cabinet maker at 8072 Morgantown Rd that builds and replaces kitchen cabinets in Russellville, Kentucky. Lance and his team work with you on the plan, then carry out the work, from new cabinets to matching replacements.

One customer had a flood-damaged kitchen. Lance's team matched and replaced the cabinets and counters, and the homeowner says they were completely satisfied with the help in planning, the time to completion, the price and the quality of the work. Other customers call the team very prompt and available. The photos show the range: a bright white kitchen under a coffered ceiling and a cream glazed kitchen with a tall wood hood.

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Chapel Cabinet Company is listed on Google as a cabinet maker, and kitchen cabinets are its main work. The photos show raised-panel doors with a glazed cream finish, carved columns on the base cabinets, crown molding and a tall matching range hood. Ask Lance about the style you have in mind.

items.name: Matching and replacing damaged cabinets
items.blurb: Water and flood damage often ruin part of a kitchen, not all of it. For one customer, Lance and his team matched and replaced the cabinets and counters in a flood-damaged kitchen, and the homeowner would recommend them without reservation.

process.h2: How a cabinet project comes together

steps.title: Call the shop
steps.text: Call (270) 542-4051 on a weekday between 7:30 AM and 4:30 PM, or email, and tell Lance's team about your kitchen.

steps.title: Plan the work
steps.text: Talk through the layout, the cabinet style and whether counters are part of the job. Customers mention the help in planning.

steps.title: Build and replace
steps.text: Your cabinets and counters are made to fit, or matched to what you already have when only part of the kitchen is replaced.

steps.title: Walk through it
steps.text: Look over the finished kitchen together and make sure everything works the way you planned before the job is closed out.

service_area.h2: Kitchen cabinets in Russellville and nearby
service_area.text: Chapel Cabinet Company is based at 8072 Morgantown Rd in Russellville, Kentucky. The Google listing does not name a service area, so if you live outside Russellville and want to know whether Lance's team can take on your kitchen, call (270) 542-4051 on a weekday between 7:30 AM and 4:30 PM, or email crdavenport@logantele.com with your town and a short description of the job.

items.q: Where is Chapel Cabinet Company and when are you open?
items.a: The shop is at 8072 Morgantown Rd, Russellville, KY 42276. Google lists the hours as Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday. Please call (270) 542-4051 before you stop by so the right person is there to talk about your kitchen.

items.q: Can you match cabinets after flood or water damage?
items.a: Yes. Michael C. had a flood-damaged kitchen, and Lance and his team matched and replaced the cabinets and counters. He was completely satisfied with the planning, the time to completion, the price and the quality. Call to describe what was damaged in your kitchen.

items.q: Do you replace countertops as well as cabinets?
items.a: In the flood-damaged kitchen, the team replaced both the cabinets and the counters, and the kitchen photos show granite tops on islands and perimeter runs. Ask about counters when you call, so the cabinets and tops can be planned together for your kitchen.

items.q: Will you help me plan the kitchen?
items.a: Planning is part of the job. One customer specifically mentions being completely satisfied with the help in planning, and another calls the team very prompt and available. Bring your measurements, a few photos and any ideas you have, and Lance's team can talk through the options.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Call Chapel Cabinet Company at (270) 542-4051 on a weekday between 7:30 AM and 4:30 PM, or email crdavenport@logantele.com. Tell the team a little about your kitchen, whether it is a new set of cabinets or a repair after damage, and they can explain the next steps.
